component.name: rhYciv
component.summary: A crisp, high-resolution turn-based empire strategy game

description.p: rhYciv is a classic turn-based empire strategy game with a modern high-resolution renderer, deeper zoom, streamlined conquest rules, and attributed open-source artwork.
The bundled rules, interface data, fonts, and art make this a standalone game; no commercial game installation is required.

Seamless high-resolution terrain: the painted terrain diamonds now blend edge to edge with no visible tile borders, soft transitions between terrain types, a procedural shallow-water shoreline in place of the legacy coast stipple, and crisp map overlays when zoomed in. Also adds Great Library and Darwin's Voyage advance grants, a stone-panel interface pass, an F10 screenshot hotkey, a fix for a crash when founding a city, and a formula-level Civilization II parity audit.

Painted isometric terrain art for every terrain type and most special resources, working city-improvement production bonuses (Factory and the power plants), a disband-unit command, and a ranked Civilization II gameplay-parity backlog.
First runtime-standalone beta with bundled rules, cities, interface atlases, and replacement art.
First public Flatpak beta for gameplay, interface, and performance testing.
